title: Novated Leasing Break Fee and Charges - Need Ideas
body:
Hi everyone,
Looking for some advice from anyone with experience in novated leasing or vehicle finance.
The lease is with metro finance. Honestly they are bunch of shits due to their service levels.
We bought a 2024 Kia EV9 GT-Line as a demo vehicle in June 2025 and put it on my wife's salary through a novated lease.
The lease runs until July 2028, but unfortunately our circumstances have changed and we've decided we need to sell the vehicle.
We've been given a payout figure of $89,696.03, which has surprised me. We purchased the car for $89,000 plus GST, and despite making over a year's worth of lease payments (including interest and other costs), the payout amount is still basically the same as what we originally paid.
The vehicle currently has around 28,000 km on the odometer, and I'm not sure what sort of sale price we could realistically achieve in the current market.
The original lease documentation showed a residual value of approximately $42,000 at the end of the lease term.
Our monthly finance payment is:
$1,990.72 per month
(including the lease establishment fee)
Given our situation, we can probably only keep the vehicle for another three months at most, so we're trying to work out the best option and minimise any financial hit.
Has anyone been in a similar position? What did you do, and what would you recommend in our circumstances? Any advice or insights would be greatly appreciated.
Thanks in advance.
Regards
